purpose: Harden known-employee Native Auth by allowing backend nativeOnly only when the frontend is already bridge-free and all five known employees are Native-ready.
invariants: Bridge-free canary accepts nativeOnly=true when Native-ready count is at least five.
Known username aliases remain canonicalized to the exact five D1 keys.
Unknown employee usernames remain Legacy while Global Native Auth is OFF.
This repo gate does not change runtime flags.
